fields.label: Sample size recruited
fields.description: How many participants were initially recruited or enrolled?
fields.rules: Extract only an explicitly reported recruited/enrolled count. Do not substitute the analysed or active sample.

fields.label: Sample size analysed
fields.description: How many participants were included in the final analysis?
fields.rules: Extract the final analysed count. Keep distinct from recruited, registered, and active-intervention counts.

fields.label: Sample size active intervention
fields.description: How many participants were active during the gamification intervention phase?
fields.rules: Use the intervention-phase active count, not the number ever registered or active in earlier phases.

fields.label: Participant age
fields.description: What participant age information is explicitly reported?
fields.rules: Return the reported mean and SD, range, or minimum-age condition as written. Use not_reported when absent, not N/A.

fields.label: Stakeholder category
fields.description: Which stakeholder population participated in the evaluated intervention?
fields.rules: Select one or more supported categories.

fields.label: Intervention tool name
fields.description: What is the exact name of the application, game, or software framework evaluated?
fields.rules: Return the exact name used by participants in the evaluated case study. Ignore tools mentioned only in related work or back-end architecture.

fields.label: Intervention platform
fields.description: On which technical platform was the evaluated intervention delivered?
fields.rules: Identify the participant-facing delivery platform used during the intervention, not the back-end technical architecture.

fields.label: Total experiment duration
fields.description: How long did the complete study or experiment last?
fields.rules: Keep this separate from the duration of the gamification treatment phase.

fields.label: Gamification intervention duration
fields.description: How long were participants exposed specifically to the gamification intervention?
fields.rules: Extract the treatment-phase duration, not baseline, recruitment, or total study duration.

fields.label: Post-intervention follow-up performed
fields.description: Was participant behaviour measured after the intervention ended?
fields.rules: Return true only when post-intervention monitoring is explicitly described, false only when its absence is explicit, and not_reported otherwise.

fields.label: Post-intervention follow-up duration
fields.description: For how long were participants followed after the intervention ended?
fields.rules: Extract only an explicit post-intervention period. Do not infer zero from silence.

fields.label: Encouraged transport modes
fields.description: Which sustainable transport modes did the intervention explicitly encourage?
fields.rules: Return a list of modes directly connected to the intervention, excluding modes mentioned only as background or outcomes.
